detail: Secondary schooling in Saint-Cloud, the commune adjacent to the family's Montretout estate. Date thinly sourced (biographical accounts).
Completed a law degree at Panthéon-Assas. Her status as 'avocate' (lawyer) is confirmed on her official Assemblée nationale profile.

Postgraduate diploma in criminal law. She subsequently obtained the lawyer's professional certificate (CAPA) and practised at the Paris bar; the exact CAPA record and precise bar years are reported by biographical sources rather than a primary bar-association record (thinly sourced).
